title: Ron Bacardi Limón Oval Shaped Ringed Shot Glass
descriptionText: The Ron Bacardi Limón Oval Shaped Ringed Shot Glass is a stylish and practical addition to any barware collection. This shot glass features a unique oval shape with an embossed Bacardi Limón design, making it perfect for all occasions. Made of clear glass and with a capacity of ~1oz, this decorative shot glass is sure to impress your guests and add a touch of sophistication to your home bar. Perfect for both hot and cold beverages, this shot glass is a must-have for any collector or home enthusiast.
